scope: exploratory single Codex-agent content annotation; condition labels masked; not a human study
rule: action_suggestion=true only when SAY explicitly proposes an action the user could take. Optional suggestions/questions with a concrete action count. Mere empathy, asking what happened, or saying the user can choose does not count. Judge text only, not inferred intentions. Include one short exact evidence quote when true.

items.say: 问不问，看你更想要什么。想弄清楚，就问一句“最近是不是忙”，别一开口就像在要个说法。问了对方含糊带过，也不用追着问。不想问也行，联系少了不一定是你做错了什么。

items.user: 朋友回消息变少了，我拿不准该不该问他原因。你怎么看？
items.say: 想问就问，但别问成“你为什么老不回我”。换成“最近是不是忙，感觉你回得少了”，对方好接，你也不用一直猜。问一次就好，别追着问。

items.user: 朋友回消息变少了，我拿不准该不该问他原因。你怎么看？
